title: Step 9, question 1: border of ghost buttons on hover and press
note:
Question 1: the ghost border on hover and press. Look at the hover and active columns. today: no border in any state. today + border: the subtle border one step behind, as Figma does and as the ghost fill already does (decision ghost-tint-one-step-behind): hover takes the subtle resting border (global.border.subtle.<family>.default), press the subtle hover border (…hover). The border needs no contrast (WCAG 1.4.11: the label identifies the button). Existing tokens only.

Zoomed × 2.5 so the 0.6 px border shows.
